said it has initiated a cost transformation and enterprise restructuring program to improve its cost structure and evolve its operating model around two focused businesses, Core Diagnostics and Point of Care Diagnostics.
The Board also approved the elimination of the role of Chief Operations Officer, leading to the termination of Phil McLellan as COO.

In connection with the plan, effective November 9, 2026, QuidelOrtho has appointed Jonathan Siegrist to serve in the newly created role of Head of Point of Care Diagnostics and Bryan Hanson to serve in the newly created role of Head of Core Diagnostics.

Before their appointment to such roles, Siegrist served as QuidelOrtho’s Executive Vice President of Research & Development & Chief Technology Officer, and Hanson served as Executive Vice President, Global Portfolio Management and Marketing.

title: QuidelOrtho launches restructuring program, eliminates COO role
